question: Which of the following is a major component of bio-gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __"**Methane**".__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Biogas:**

__
 
• It is created when **bacteria break down organic material** when there is no oxygen present.
 
• ***Methane*** makes up: **50–75% of biogas,** followed by** carbon dioxide (25%–50%)**, nitrogen (0–10%), and** hydrogen (0–1%).**
 
• Methane is therefore the ***primary ingredient*** in biogas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **sustainable energy source** called biogas is created when certain** bacteria break down organic material** in **anaerobic environments.**
 
• **Methane**, **hydrogen**, and **carbon dioxide** are all present in them.
 
• **Agricultural waste**, **food waste**, **animal dung**, **manure**, and **sewage** can contribute to its production.
 
• **Anaerobic digestion** is another name for the procedure that creates biogas.
 
• Methane can burn because it is a **combustible gas**.
 
• This gas is distributed to numerous locations where it is used for **lighting** and** cooking**.
 
• It is an **environmentally friendly gas** that lessens the use of fossil fuels and other environmental issues.
